items: [Faster Everyday Performance with Intel N6000] Equipped with the Intel Pentium Silver N6000 processor (4 cores, up to 3.3GHz), offering a noticeable speed boost over older Celeron chips. Great for browsing, streaming, multitasking, and schoolwork without slowdowns. This laptop is upgraded based on model 82LX00G1US.

[15.6” Full HD Display for Clear, Comfortable Viewing] Enjoy crisp visuals on a 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) LCD w/LED Backlight anti-glare, 220nits screen—perfect for watching videos, attending online classes, or working on documents.

[Up to 36GB RAM & Dual Storage - Smooth Multitasking] Up to 36GB of RAM keeps apps running smoothly, even with multiple tabs open. Comes with both up to 2TB SSD + 128GB eMMC for fast boot-up and plenty of space for files and media.
[All the Ports You Need] Includes USB-C, HDMI, USB-A, SD card reader, and audio jack. Easily connect to monitors, projectors, and accessories—no dongle required.

[Long Battery Life + Windows 11 + Webcam] Up to 10 hours of battery life with Windows 11 Home pre-installed. Includes 720p webcam with privacy shutter—ready for Zoom calls, Teams meetings, and video chats.
